Project Hospital: a realistic take on hospital simulation

notes

Interview with Jan Benes, lead programmer at Oxymoron Games: examinations uncover symptoms and enough symptoms give a diagnosis; symptom frequency tuned so one exam rarely suffices; dangerous hidden symptoms must be found and treated in time; based on real medicine with input from professionals.
